summary: The change scopes the Tech Week client to exact configured origins and callbacks, rejects public and loopback development shortcuts for it, and adds regression coverage for attacker-controlled origins and redirects.

evidence: src/auth_config.ts lines 290-307 skip the development HTTP shortcut for techweek-2026-event-picker so both origin and callback checks fall through to exact membership in the client lists.

src/config_test.ts lines 156-186 verifies each configured Tech Week origin and redirect URI is accepted while attacker-controlled HTTPS and HTTP origins, including matching callback paths, are rejected.
The Tech Week registration added at src/config_test.ts lines 34-51 contains only HTTPS origins and redirect URIs, leaving no non-loopback plain-HTTP target in the checked-in registration fixture.
src/config_test.ts lines 565-591 preserves local-network development behavior for other clients while excluding Tech Week from the arbitrary-port loopback fallback.
